executiveSummary.headline: Restore a Verifiable Canonical Source and Complete Core Decision Facts
executiveSummary.lead: Hotel Phillips reaches 45 of 60 eligible scenarios and ranks second among six certified Hilton Honors peers, but AI Consideration is 32.1%. The immediate constraint is source control: the supplied canonical domain redirects to Hilton and returned a reference-code/403 response in the bounded probe, while meeting, historic, dining, and location attributes remain incomplete or absent in the certified read.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses the named governed peer set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.
